# Aureum Mall & Residences

> A 16 kanal mixed-use destination at the Bahria Town Ring Road Interchange, Lahore, Pakistan. Developed by Alfalah Real Estate & Builders (AREB).

## Project summary

Aureum Mall & Residences combines retail shopping, a food court, a playland, corporate offices, a planned luxury hotel and residential apartments in a single building at the Bahria Town Ring Road Interchange. Construction began on 1 October 2026 with the groundbreaking ceremony.

## Current prices (November 2026)

| Category | Sizes | Rate per sq ft | Starting price (PKR) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Studio apartment | 426 sq ft | PKR 20,500 | 8,733,000 |
| 1-bedroom apartment | 622–658 sq ft | PKR 20,500–21,500 | 13,373,000 |
| 2-bedroom apartment | 1,103–1,381 sq ft | PKR 20,500–21,500 | 23,714,500 |
| Signature Glass Apartment | 1,491–1,727 sq ft | PKR 23,000 | 34,293,000 |
| Corporate office | 1,007–2,595 sq ft | PKR 25,000 | 25,175,000 |
| First-floor shop | 172–707 sq ft | PKR 50,000 | 8,600,000 |
| Second-floor shop | 478–643 sq ft | PKR 42,500 | 20,315,000 |
| Food court unit | 301 sq ft | PKR 75,000 | 22,575,000 |
| Ground-floor retail | Large-format | On request | On request |

Applicable 10% category charges are additional. Prices, payment plans and availability require final confirmation.

## Payment plans

- **Apartments and offices:** 10% booking, 15% confirmation, 55 monthly instalments of 1%, and 20% on completion (4.5-year plan).
- **Shops and food court:** 10% booking, 15% confirmation, 42 monthly instalments of 1%, 13% across 6 half-yearly instalments, and 20% on completion (3.5-year plan).

## Location

Bahria Town Ring Road Interchange, Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan. Approximately 15 minutes from Allama Iqbal International Airport and accessible from DHA, Kalma Chowk, Raiwind Road and the Lahore Ring Road.

## Developer

Alfalah Real Estate & Builders (AREB), based in Karachi. Previous projects include Alfalah Tower, Karachi.
